pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Patches exhibit high edge angularity with complex, serrated boundaries resembling star-like or dendritic shapes. Pixel gradients at the borders are moderately sharp, with high spatial frequency along the perimeter of each dark region.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of narrow, light-colored interstitial pathways separates the patches. The topological graph features frequent tri-junction and quad-junction nodes with relatively uniform pixel thickness across the mid-flank.
